verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own docs list "file transfer in both directions" as a core session feature, and the repo includes a clipboard file copy-and-paste library for Windows, Linux and macOS. One hands-on report says clipboard file copy-paste from Linux to Windows didn't work. That covers only one path of the clipboard method, not the bidirectional file transfer feature, so it caps quality rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the file transfer workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of in-session file transfer, and evidence that cross-OS clipboard file paste works reliably.
